mapper.select: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS date, SUM(total_tokens) AS data FROM ai_chat_token WHERE creator = #{creator} AND create_time >= CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01') AND create_time < CONCAT(#{year} + 1, '-01-01') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
